_about: Farm animals and the dog (Animals, scripts/animals/animals.gd). Every number here is ours (WORKLOG 2026-10-31 Chickens, and Barn animals and the dog). Happiness runs 0..happy_max; it moves once a night (Animals.day_end) and an hour at a time while the animals are outside (hour_passed).

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken._happy_start: A bought or newly hatched chicken.
chicken._adult_days: A hatched chick grows up after this many nights; only adults lay.
chicken._price: What the store asks (data/shops.json holds the real price): a hen pays about 40 G a day after feed, so she pays back in about 5 weeks.

cow.name: Cow
cow._adult_days: A calf (Game.add_animal("cow", true)) grows up after this many nights; only grown cows give milk.
cow._gives: Product every N fed, healthy nights (prod_days). It waits until taken and doesn't pile up. The tool hangs in the barn: E on the animal uses it.

breed.born: %s had a calf in the barn: %s.
breed.waits: %s is due, but the barn is full. Make room for the calf.
breed._breed: Nights from the musubi cord to the calf (Animals.breed). 12 nights without milk is about 1,800 G (150 a day after fodder), so with the cord a calf costs about 2,400 against the store's 3,200: worth it, not a money machine.

cow._price: What the store asks (data/shops.json; a calf 3200): a cow gives 110-240 G a day, about 150 after fodder, so she pays back in about 6 weeks.

sheep.name: Sheep
sheep._gives: Wool grows back over 3 fed, healthy nights; the sheep looks shorn until then.

breed.born: %s had a lamb in the barn: %s.
breed.waits: %s is due, but the barn is full. Make room for the lamb.
breed._breed: 9 nights: three wool cycles missed (about 900 G), with the cord about 1,500 against the store's 1,900 for a lamb.

sheep._price: What the store asks (data/shops.json; a lamb 1900): 180-420 G of wool every 3 days (60-140 G a day) for the same fodder as a cow.

coop._capacity: Chickens (and eggs in the incubator) the coop holds; one feed box place each.
coop._feed_start: Portions of chicken feed in the sack on a new game (Game.animals.add_feed adds more).
coop._spots: Coop cells where animal 0, 1, ... stand inside (the coop map); one per place.
coop._yard: Farm cells x, y, w, h where the hens peck about when they are out (not solid).
coop.out_news: The hens were out all night.

barn._capacity: Cows and sheep together; one stall and one fodder box place each.
barn._feed_start: Bundles of hay fodder in the loft on a new game (Game.animals.add_fodder adds more).
barn._spots: Stall cells in the barn map, one per place.
barn._yard: Farm cells in front of the barn where the cows and sheep graze when out (clear of the pond and the gate path).
barn.out_news: The barn animals were out all night.

happiness._fed: Ate from the feed box, or grazed outside long enough.
happiness._grazing_hours: Hours outside in good weather that count as a meal (no feed taken).
happiness._sun: Extra for a day with at least grazing_hours outside in good weather.
happiness._bad_weather_hour: Per hour outside while it rains, storms or snows.
happiness._left_out_night: Still outside when the day ends; they come back in by themselves.
happiness._petted: Once a day, by talking to / stroking the animal.
happiness._brushed: Once a day with the barn brush (cows and sheep).

_good_weather: Weather in which the animals may go out (Animals.can_go_out).
_out_hours: The hatch and the barn gate open from the first hour to the last (inclusive).

sickness._below: At or under this happiness a night may make an animal sick.
sickness._unfed_chance: Extra chance for a night without food.
sickness._recover_days: Without medicine an animal gets well by itself after this many nights (DESIGN: risks must be recoverable).
sickness._medicine: The rucksack item that cures at once (sold by a shop later).

breeding._item: A red-and-white braided cord the Yorozu Store sells (data/shops.json). Held up and tied on a cow's or ewe's stall (E on her in the barn) it asks the hill herdsman's bull or ram to call that night; our own idea, after a shrine's musubi knot.
breeding._happy_min: Only a grown, well cow or ewe at least this happy will carry: care comes first.
breeding._born_happy: A calf or lamb born on the farm starts this much happier than a bought one (happy_start).

incubator._hatch_days: Nights until an egg in the incubator hatches into a chick.

egg._grades: The egg laid is the first grade whose 'below' is over the hen's happiness.

_names: Given in turn to new animals.
_start: Animals a new game (or a save from before animals) begins with.

dog.name: Goro
dog._about: The farm dog: always on the farm, follows the farmer once fond enough, else wanders near home.
dog._home: Farm cell the dog wakes up on each morning, right of the stand.
dog._petted: Once a day, E facing the dog.
dog._lifted: Once a day, picking it up (E again after petting).
dog._ignored: A night without petting or picking it up.
dog._follow_affection: From this affection on the dog follows the farmer (about a week of petting).
dog._follow: Follows when the farmer is more than follow_from and at most follow_range cells away (steps along the grid).
dog._wander: Otherwise a step this often, staying this many cells from home.
dog._step_seconds: Real seconds between steps (the view slides between cells).
